data.rationale: The proposal covers only the search-and-open-restaurant part of the true workflow and omits the key Notify click and preferred-time selection and confirm, so it describes a search/availability check instead of setting a notification; its parameters (city, query, date, party size) partly overlap but miss time, and its steps are vague ("review results") and not enough to automate the notification task.
